items.title: SDK TypeScript Release sdk-typescript-v0.1.39
items.en_oneliner: Qwen Code's TypeScript SDK ships v0.1.39, bundling CLI versions 0.28.7 and 0.28.6 so developers can integrate it directly through the SDK.

items.title: Taking Trainium3 to the Track: Generating Videos with LTX-2.5
items.en_title: Taking Trainium3 to the Track: Generating Videos with LTX-2.5
items.en_oneliner: Hugging Face moved LTX-2.5 onto AWS Trainium3 with tensor and sequence parallelism, generating a 10-second 2048x1024 clip with sound in about 22 seconds on half the machine, matching the paid API, and built a shot-chaining workflow for drafting short films along the way.

items.title: v2.76.0 (2026-11-26)
items.en_oneliner: Realtime sessions can now reveal tools mid-conversation, requests to Gemini 2.5 Pro and Flash trigger deprecation warnings, and Pax adds computer-use desktop sandboxes.

items.title: Release v0.28.7
items.en_oneliner: Qwen Code CLI lands on the Harness kernel, usage statistics stay off unless you opt in, and repeated tool-call rejections now come with clearer explanations.
